description: This file defines and builds Kubernetes controller cluster roles and role bindings for RBAC authorization, including specific roles for various controllers like attachdetach, deployment, node, and others, with feature-gated roles for advanced features.

methods.name: addControllerRole
methods.description: Adds a controller role and its binding to the respective slices, ensuring role name prefix and uniqueness, and labeling.

methods.name: eventsRule
methods.description: Creates a PolicyRule for event resource permissions.

methods.name: buildControllerRoles
methods.description: Constructs and returns slices of controller cluster roles and role bindings with permissions for various Kubernetes controllers, with feature-gated roles.
